description: This file manages Feishu account resolution and client creation within a plugin API, including configuration reading, account ID normalization, and feature flag merging.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalAccountId
methods.description: Normalizes an optional account ID by trimming whitespace or returning undefined.

methods.name: readConfiguredDefaultAccountId
methods.description: Reads the default Feishu account ID from plugin configuration.

methods.name: resolveImplicitToolAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID to use, prioritizing explicit, contextual, then default configuration.

methods.name: resolveFeishuToolAccount
methods.description: Resolves and returns a Feishu account object based on provided parameters.

methods.name: createFeishuToolClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a Feishu client instance for the resolved account.

methods.name: resolveAnyEnabledFeishuToolsConfig
methods.description: Merges and returns the enabled features across multiple Feishu accounts.
